answer: Because of that, each duplicate self costs 3 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the harbor record makes public exactly who is still on probation. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the fable queue naming the meadow that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 3 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
